nom: TruSkin Brightening Vitamin C Serum for Face with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the serum helped clear blemishes and reduce breakouts without making their skin greasier.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the serum leaves skin hydrated and smoother, though a few say it still feels tight or dry until a moisturizer is layered on top.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily-to-combination skin says the serum shifted her skin toward a combination feel without drying it out.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several describe stinging, redness, or breakouts after applying it, while others, including some with eczema, report no irritation at all.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin reports only mild dryness or tightness from the hyaluronic acid, with no other issues.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s report visible improvements in skin tone, tightening, and fine lines with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the serum for fine lines, sagging, or uneven tone mostly report gradual tightening and smoother-looking skin over weeks to months; one reviewer, however, describes a deep new wrinkle and thinner, fragile skin after applying it under her eyes against instructions.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the serum hydrates well and leaves skin softer, but several note it needs to be followed immediately by a moisturizer or it leaves a tight, dry feeling.
concerns.redness: Reports are split: several reviewers say the serum reduced redness and calmed rosacea over time, while others describe new redness, a hot or sunburn-like sensation, or eye irritation after applying it.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers describe an initial stinging or burning sensation on first use, which some note the brand says is normal for potent vitamin C; a minority report lasting reactions such as swelling, itching, or needing medical treatment.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers who used the serum for dark spots, sun spots, freckles, or melasma report gradual fading and a more even tone over several weeks to months, though a few saw little to no change in the short term.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are sharply divided: many reviewers say the serum cleared acne, faded scars, and reduced breakouts, while a comparable number report it caused new breakouts or worsened acne, sometimes leaving dark scars.

aspects.libelle: Leaky bottle or broken dropper on arrival
Slight stickiness or tightness while drying

extraits.texte: I got this on the 9th and immediately started using it twice a day. Says smooth on face and under eyes so I thought... Wow, a product we can use on under eye skin. Eye skin is so different then the rest of your face. There are 3 pics. One of my right, left and both eyes. My eyes after a week started itching and got irritated so I reduced the amount. As of now I stopped completely just shy of 2 weeks. My eye got inflamed, irritated and I went from barely having any wrinkles to a very DEEP wrinkle on one of my eyes. I am so embarrassed by it. My skin feels thin and fragile and I don't think at this moment that it will ever look the same. For the first week I noticed brightness. But now they have since darkened. I am 34 and I have always used face creams so I know that there shouldnt be a wrinkle that deep under my eye. I bought this because I had a baby 3 months ago and the freckles on my face darkened during pregnancy. It helped reduce the darkened freckles on my face a little but it wasn't worth an embarrassing deep wrinkle under my eye. I feel like it has aged me in the long run and it's a horrible feeling. If you use this... please caution on your eyes. Bottle says to rub under eyes too but I would just advice the face, forehead and neck.

extraits.titre: Made my skin break out SO BAD - EDITED
extraits.texte: So first off I want to start by saying I have very sensitive skin. I bought this product thinking it was good for sensitive skin, and boy was I wrong. When I first applied this serum on my face, it started stinging like crazy. Thinking it's just my skin acting up, and I wanted to give this product a solid try before I give up seeing as there were SOOOOO many good reviews. After 2-3 days of using this, this is what my face looked like vs what my skin looked like before using this product. EDIT: changed my review from 1 to 3 stars because of their AMAZING customer service. Not only did they offer a refund because the product didn't work out, they also spent some time asking about my skin type and recommended another product that may be more suitable for my skin type. I've went through a fair share of skin care products as well as companies (since my skin so extremely sensitive x.x), and TruSkin's customer service is by far the best and most genuine.

extraits.titre: Works great to brighten skin and even texture
extraits.texte: I purchased this for the severe hyperpigmentation around my eyes. I have eczema and some of the cream I’ve used have caused the skin to discolor and darken. I’ve been using the product a few weeks now and am noticing a good improvement in the texture and color of my skin. My daughter asked me the other day if I had makeup on and I said no, she replied how good my skin looked! I haven’t heard a compliment like that in a long time. I use the product twice a day as suggested, after I clean and tone. I will definitely continue to purchase this product as it is now a staple in my daily skin care regimen. Also, as stated above I do have eczema and this is sensitive enough that it causes no irritation to my extremely sensitive skin, so if you have sensitive skin do the patch test as recommended, but know it works well on my sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Great Product for Late Skincare Bloomers
extraits.texte: I was never been serious about skincare...until I turned 70. I went from having a natural oil slick on my face most of my life to someone with very dry skin. I had no idea how to choose a good skincare product, but I ran across a glowing review for TruSkin about 2 yrs ago, and I've been hooked ever since. I apply it immediately after I wash my face and neck, and the dryness that I would normally experience is not a factor. The effects of aging are particularly pronounced around my neck, but TruSkin improves the appearance of sagging and wrinkling to the point that I'm no longer self-conscious about it. My skin is also sensitive and products will often make me break out. I have never had any such ill effects with TruSkin. If I'm leaving the house, I'll apply a moisturizer and sunscreen over it, but if I'm in for the day, it's often all that I'll use. I think TruSkin is a great product, at a great price point, and I like that I don't need a host of other complimentary products to see results.

I normally never write a review but I just had to with this product. I started about two to three weeks ago with it and it has done miracles to my skin! I am normally oily to combination skin and I had such a problem with it all my life and having to keep putting more products to take the shine off made me always break out. After using this on my skin it changed my skin to combination but not dry at the same time so that really made me happy. On top with all my scaring most of it is gone! I try to use it every night or every other night but this product is definitely a must buy for those who struggle with scars and or oily skin. I’m so much happier with my skin and not putting so much makeup to cover it. Thank you so much to whoever makes this product! Will be buying more!

extraits.titre: Evens skin tone better than any other product I've ever used!
extraits.texte: This serum is just as amazing as everyone says it is. I am 67 years old, and I have light melasma on both of my cheekbones. I have done *everything* to get rid of it, i.e., microdermabrasion, other serums, clarisonic exfoliation, and on and on ad nauseum. I wear SPF 50-70 on my face 365 days a year, and I've done that for decades. I also drink a lot of water. It looked as good as it was going to get. Now, my skin looks even better, and the melasma has never been lighter. Overall, my skin tone just looks very even and smooth. In my picture, you can see how even my skin tone is, and I do not wear foundation. I believe the key is to use this product every single day, along with high SPF moisturizing sunscreen versus other treatments like microdermabrasion which are only done every so often. Every morning when I look in the mirror at my face, I marvel at how smooth it looks for my age. This is such a terrific product. I just finished my first bottle and I'm on to my second one. I will continue to include all the other parts of my skin care regimen, because they really all do add up. But this Vitamin C serum has make the biggest difference at all. Yay!

Ok so I’ve been using for a little past a week now and so far so good. My solution is on the cloudy side but cloudy is actually good. Means it does contain ascorbic acid (vitamin C), unlike that last brand i threw away. If you don’t know Vitamin C is unstable and oxides rather quickly. So rather it’s cloudy, yellow, orange or brown, it’s a good sign. To limit the turn over I refrigerate mines. NOW, I have normal skin, I do not break out frequently only if I slip on my face cleaning regime or slow down on my water intake two things I’ve done prior to purchasing this product, idk why. In my August dated selfie that was my skin in its regular appearance of a natural glow as for the selfie dated this month 9/20/2020 I became lazy on my regime prior to purchase and missed a few too many nightly cleanings and just decided what the heck I need a new vitamin c to try anyway. Best way to do so and see if it truly works is to void my skin of the old one. That would be the one I threw away, yes I reviewed that garbage. (Hence the small pimple). The pimple is gone completely... that’s normal for me so can’t attribute that to the serum. As a few have mentioned, it does cause a tightness (dry skin) that I expected due to the hyaluronic. I know from experience that dries out my skin until I apply my moisturizer. If your moisturizer isn’t replenishing afterwards you may just need a different one.
